summary.text: Stefano Famiglietti is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 4 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
An attorney, he took office on August 14, 2025, after winning a special election to succeed Dominick Ruggerio.

paragraphs.text: Stefano Famiglietti earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Rhode Island in 2013 and a graduate degree from Roger Williams University School of Law in 2016.
His career experience includes working as an attorney.
Famiglietti defeated Republican Alexander Asermely in the August 5, 2025, special general election for Rhode Island State Senate District 4, with 83.0% of the vote.
His current term ends on January 5, 2027.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
